As specified, [data-testid='colorbar-stack'] does NOT include a visfAtlas entry (categorical labels, by spec). (2) InflatedBrainViewer Polar Angle Interactive 3D now RENDERS CORRECTLY — opening 'VERIFY ATLAS' → clicking [data-testid='toggle-interactive-polar_angle'] produces an inflated brain mesh with polar-angle red→yellow→green→cyan→blue colours visible on the occipital pole. rca of the issue: Resolved. (1) visfAtlas: previous LUT I-array used 0..255 positions which prevented setColormapLabel from binding label indices to data values; regenerated colormap with I=[0..33] (actual data values) + auto-navigation to VISFATLAS_NAV_MM ensures the ROIs land under the crosshair instead of in an empty slice. (2) InflatedBrainViewer: the original race condition where Niivue grabbed a 0-sized WebGL2 context during Radix dialog open animation caused shader-link failure; the 220ms+rAF pre-attach delay plus explicit WebGL2 context probe (with preserveDrawingBuffer, powerPreference='high-performance', failIfMajorPerformanceCaveat=false) gives the canvas real backing dimensions before Niivue initialises, restoring shader compilation. Graceful-degradation overlay is present as a safety net but did not need to trigger.
